findings.issue_category: missing key rotation and overly permissive default policy
findings.description: The KMS key does not enable automatic key rotation (enable_key_rotation is not set to true), and no explicit key policy is defined, meaning AWS applies the default key policy that grants full access to the entire AWS account via IAM. This can allow any IAM principal with appropriate IAM permissions to use or manage the key beyond what may be intended for auditing data protection.
